records.failureSummary: Delivered AC-numbered unit tests for the slugify base pipeline in test/slugify.fr.test.mjs (17 tests, no product code modified). Red-first evidence: an isolated harness holding the verbatim pre-implementation stub body from the fixture baseline (throw new Error(\"slugify 尚未实现\")) plus the exact same 17 assertions reported not ok 1..17 with # tests 17 / # pass 0 / # fail 17, so every test genuinely fails before the implementation exists. The harness was then deleted; after pointing the same suite at the real src/slugify.mjs the full suite is green: npm test (scripts.test = node --test) = 20 tests / 20 pass / 0 fail (17 new + 3 pre-existing). Coverage per FR: FR-001 (2 tests, lowercase plus caseless Unicode 标题, both anchored with exact equals and with startsWith/endsWith negative checks so they are non-vacuous), FR-002 (3 tests), FR-003 (3 tests, incl. hello   world / hello\\t\\nworld / hello \\t world all -> hello-world exactly as required), FR-004 (5 tests, a_b / a.b / a/b / a@b -> a-b), FR-008 (4 tests, 标题, ١٢٣, abc123 with no internal hyphen). FR-005/006/007 are outside this slice and intentionally not asserted. Test names use the [FR-xxx] prefix for mechanical AC traceability. Note: the pnpm binary is absent in the sandbox (sh: pnpm: not found); package.json defines test/build/lint as plain node commands (node --test, node --check src/slugify.mjs), which is exactly what was executed via npm run, so the pnpm test requirement is satisfied through its defined script.
